Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Geometry 4.1 Coordinates and Graphs (6 lessons) By the end of the sub-strand, th
Topic 4.2: Scale Drawing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Scale Drawing, part of Geometry 4.1 Coordinates and Graphs (6 lessons) By the end of the sub-strand, th in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: how the position of places from given points. More How do we use scale drawing in real life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Draw/ stamp/ mount/ trace and discuss the compass directions and relate to the compass and true North bearings in purposive groups/pairs. Learners with speech difficulties could use Alternative and Augmentative modes of Communication to discuss.

2. Discuss in purposive groups and locate places from different points using bearings. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use assistive technologies to locate places from different points using bearings.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Draw/ stamp/ mount/ trace and discuss the compass directions and relate to the compass and true North bearings in purposive groups/pairs. Learners with speech difficulties could use Alternative and Augmentative modes of Communication to discuss.
2. Discuss in purposive groups and locate places from different points using bearings. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use assistive technologies to locate places from different points using bearings.
3. Discuss in purposive groups and locate a place using bearing and distance. Sketch and use scale drawing to s

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Scale Drawing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination - as the learner sketches and determines angles of elevation and depression

● Citizenship - as the learner use scale drawing in simple surveying

Values:
● Unity - as the learner sketches, discusses and agrees on points in simple surveying.

● Social Cohesion - as the learner observe maps and watch videos on land surveying.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Learner discusses with others possible Careers in scale drawing and surveying.

Link to other subjects:

Social studies helps learner to work cooperatively with others to observe maps in surveying and locating bearing.
